newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Another injunction issued suspending CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Another injunction issued suspending CVRD sale.

text.p: Another Brazilian judge has issued an injunction suspending the privatization auction of state mining giant CVRD, said a spokeswoman for Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).
She said the injunction was granted on grounds that the tender document for the April 29 sale of a 40-45-percent voting stake in CVRD was not published in English.
She said the BNDES, which oversees the privatization process, would appeal the ruling.
The injunction, issued by a federal judge in the northeastern state of Maranhao, is the second court ruling that could suspend tomorrow's auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.
On Friday, a Sao Paulo federal judge issued an injunction against the auction which the BNDES is already contesting.
More than 60 lawsuits have been filed in courts across Brazil against Latin America's largest privatization to date.

Brazil's highest court, the Supreme Federal Tribunal (STF), is due to rule later today on a second constitutional challenge to the sell-off brought by the Order of Brazilian Lawyers (OAB), a guild representing Brazil's legal profession.
The government and the BNDES are confident, however, that they can fight off all the challenges to the CVRD sale and hold the auction as planned at 1000 local time/1300 GMT Tuesday.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
